name: notion-mcp-server
description: Read and write Notion with a token: search pages, query databases with typed filters, read and write pages as markdown, and batch edits. Runs the open-source notion-mcp-server locally; not made by Notion.

notion_token.title: Notion token
notion_token.description: Personal Access Token (ntn_...) or Internal Integration Secret. Create one at https://app.notion.com/developers/tokens — a PAT sees everything you can see, no per-page sharing needed.

notion_page_id.title: Default parent page (optional)
notion_page_id.description: Page URL or ID used by create_page / create_database when no parent is given. Leave empty to always pass a parent.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Turn on to disable every write operation, so the server can only search and read.
